## Scope and decision

Draft cumulative validation of delivery `bf308589e21b524d0ddc6e571b260f5e94a853f0`; broad production remains **HOLD**. This branch preserves the 23-node/34-edge DAG, 73 paths, eight registered suites, ten interactions, negative results, and cumulative correction budgets. PR95/99 conditional chemical input is not integrated.

## Results and limits

- Eight bounded suites exited 0 at `a1a459f2`; release tests reported 2055 passed and 76 ignored. Compile-only, ignored, diagnostic timing and physical qualification are distinct.
- A fixed manufactured F6 whole-path certificate at `29931029` passed an independent Fraction oracle on 992 slabs; the error cap was first met at 256 subdivisions. This is not general client or solver qualification.
- Q-GIVENS exact-residual current-profile tests passed at `0255297e`; historical profile discrepancies remain open.
- Q-API downstream fixtures reproduce source compatibility failures E0063 and E0004. Full authority is FAIL; Q-LEDGER correction budget is exhausted at 3/3. Ten interaction gates remain open.
- Offline vendor all-target check and installed SUNDIALS/MPI adapter tests passed in their specified local scope. Cross-platform and deployment qualification remain open.
- Diagnostic performance includes adverse results, unequal cubic checksums and a reentrant adapter loss; no broad performance claim is made.

## Source and evidence

Prior validation delivery: `3ab0802740963386967935e807a5a72cfeeac521` / `c7f2cf985312355ade05d2f909959888693be7d9`. Native source pins and remote execution branch are specified in the report. Checker source `c9c734529cf5bbbc33683987006bf71fca3f122d` passed 41 targeted tests. Independent read-only review: PASS_SCOPED only.

[Report](research/local_dynamics_qualification_20261029/REPORT_KO.md) · [Machine-readable status](research/local_dynamics_qualification_20261029/SUMMARY.json) · [Next handoff](research/local_dynamics_qualification_20261029/NEXT_HANDOFF_KO.md) · [Evidence manifest](research/local_dynamics_qualification_20261029/evidence/MANIFEST.json). Large raw remains locally at `/home/cosmosapjw/evidence-20261028T170155Z` with SHA-256 links.

## Final-tree checks

At `3ab08027`, `check-research-node.py --base bf308589e21b524d0ddc6e571b260f5e94a853f0` exited 0; full `check-authority-refs.py` exited 1 with 31 missing, 16 repository-unavailable, 11 invalid-repository and 4 unreachable identities. Main-base node check previously exited 1 with 40 inherited diagnostics. Raw whitespace in preserved logs is intentionally unmodified. No merge or production deployment is requested.

## Scoped Rust allocation optimization follow-up

Delivery `bc5ddbe42b24b1a6364bf653c3e2d6d938ca4087`, tree `99c689e575f8b605d87bee98fb738267b2aca451`; actual native execution source `a682f609a1f2db1da714bea6da671b362f56baf4` remains separately pinned. Baseline source is `80bd038a13a3623e6220b9725d5c1ad4f7611fcf`.

- Reuse dense/banded FD scratch, wire the existing in-place dense callback, and reuse existing stage buffers for time FD. No solver/controller/tolerance/permission/arithmetic-policy changes; Cargo.lock is unchanged.
- Final-source FD tests: 40 integration + 13 unit passed; scoped time-FD/clone tests and strict focused Clippy passed. Eighteen returned-checkpoint/Stats/callback pairs match exactly; endpoint max error 4.46171e-9 under the diagnostic analytic cap 1e-5. This is not all-accepted-state/dense-interior qualification or a rigorous reference uncertainty bound.
- Whole-solve allocations: dense337→324, banded334→318, time-JVP401→386, autonomous control389→389. Entire solver hot loops are not qualified allocation-free.
- Four short one-thread paired timing cohorts, Callgrind4/12, heaptrack and RSS are preserved separately. Timing is diagnostic_only, with large scatter and adverse blocks. MGS/Arnoldi/QR and remaining Arnoldi vector-pool preparation are observed bottlenecks; remaining cost is not proved mathematically necessary.
- Reentrant negative control remains: strict/RHS work1.428x and guest-instruction slope2.420x, with last-repeat-only observation and final-result drop excluded.
- Two compact evidence packets plus code allow reaggregation without large raw: 18 R2 pairs and22 reentrant pairs were independently replayed. Original failures, R1/R2 identities, missing R1 supplemental cost and the early test-diff packaging limitation remain explicit.
- Fresh read-only independent verdict: PASS_SCOPED_PUBLICATION; broad production HOLD. L-0187 appended; scoped node check passed184 rows on the final delivery tree. Full authority was not rerun for this document tree; its previous FAIL, Q-API break and open interaction gates remain.

pr102.body:
Implements an opt-in native accepted-segment certificate for the conditional scalar-affine IVP y'=-lambda*y+b. Exact stored RODAS H/stages/endpoints form a quartic; outward Bernstein/Dini bounds certify whole-slab defect/state error and strict event predicates. Actual dense-query output receives a separate pointwise rounding enclosure. Source/clock/unit/event/epoch changes and invalid adjacent error carry refuse reuse.

Validation: 13 new contract tests + 8 existing fast-dense regressions passed; strict Clippy/rustfmt passed. Independent Fraction-from-bits audit passed 381 checks (367 exact comparisons + 14 Decimal90 diagnostics) across 6 records/42 queries, including 2 actual native accepted segments. Separate theory diagnostics: 324 rational cases, 16,524 exact algebra assertions and 11,016 high-precision samples. Independent scientific/code and result/PNG reviews report zero blockers.

R1-R10 and C1-C10:20/20; auxiliary SYM02:1/1 PASS_SCOPED_NATIVE_AFFINE. Original core7/23 is inherited scoped status, delta0; central REI28/88 remains separate. The broad production/authority/GMRES/physical-client gates remain HOLD; remote failing workflows are retained in REMOTE_CI_STATUS.json.

Verified code commit:0d722b4ed71413926c76bc0037f02f3a6bbdd362. Read research/sym02_native_affine_20261029/REPORT_KO.md, ADMISSION.json, FINAL_SOURCE_IDENTITY.json, DAG_BASIS.json and NEXT_THREAD_HANDOFF_KO.md. Each stage has a committed checkpoint and actual Drive/Dropbox source-ZIP acknowledgement, with SHA256 receipts. Caller-supplied affine source/parameter/initial-error premises remain explicit; this does not supply an actual BASS30 nonlinear provider.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+name: A2+A3 GMRES inner-cycle candidate
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - ".github/workflows/a2-a3-gmres-inner-cycle.yml"
+      - "crates/rodas5p-krylov/**"
+      - "crates/rodas5p-integrators/**"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  a2-a3-gmres-candidate:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out the repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Install the pinned Rust toolchain
+        run: |
+          rustup toolchain install 1.94.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
+          rustup override set 1.94.1
+
+      - name: Run incremental-Givens unit and integration contracts
+        run: |
+          cargo test -p rodas5p-krylov --lib --locked
+          cargo test -p rodas5p-krylov --test givens_gmres_contracts --locked -- --nocapture
+
+      - name: Run the directly affected Krylov suite
+        run: cargo test -p rodas5p-krylov --all-targets --locked
+
+      - name: Compile downstream integrator targets
+        run: cargo test -p rodas5p-integrators --all-targets --no-run --locked
+
+      - name: Lint the changed and downstream crates
+        run: |
+          cargo clippy -p rodas5p-krylov --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
+          cargo clippy -p rodas5p-integrators --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
+
+      - name: Check formatting and tracked-source stability
+        run: |
+          cargo fmt --all -- --check
+          git diff --check
+          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
